(Currently amended) A method for selecting a first server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising the steps of: accessing a second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __the information being added as a unique signature included in a hyperlink of a Web page of the second server computer that references the data to be sent to the client computer__; and selecting the first server computer based on the information __contained in an HTTP request generated by a Web browser from the hyperlink after selection of the hyperlink by the client computer__.
